# P37.50 — Agenda platforms v2 (R11-ACQ-22)

Round-11 row 475 · `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/475_P37.50__agenda-platforms-v2.md live_verification=false` · base `r11/P37.49-federal-datasets-family`

## What this is

The I8 §6.2 **agenda platforms v2** wave: four reviewed shared **HTML
index contracts** on the procurement connector's agenda-tenant path,
wired behind the gate to the ten ACQ-22 seats — Durham, Hialeah, Bexar
and Savannah on CivicPlus AgendaCenter; Jersey City and Dallas County on
iCompass CivicWeb; Frisco, Tampa and Maricopa County on Hyland OnBase
Agenda Online; and Fargo's city-CMS year agenda archive.

`live_verification=false`: this PR lands the engineering + fixture
surfaces only. Every seat stays `ingestion_permitted=false` (HG-03
RB-04 `a`, agenda/procurement/grant/records documents) and the
operator's OP-26 Wave-D flip under ING-GO-D is the only route to a live
fetch. Not an OM-20 row — no `live` legs ran, no production mutations.

## Machinery

`connectors/procurement.py`:
- **`platform`/`source_id` split on the tenant registry** (the
  procurement-portal pattern): each generated `agenda_*` source binds ONE
  `[tenants.*]` row whose `platform` names the shared reviewed contract
  while `source_id` is the gated rights row. `tenant_targets()` filters
  on both; per-tenant `index_path`/`index_query` overrides let Fargo pin
  its year-archive page.
- **Four committed HTML index parsers** (stdlib `HTMLParser`, never
  regex): `_CivicplusIndexParser` (`tr.catAgendaRow` + the row's own
  `ViewFile/Agenda/` link — `Minutes/` never an item),
  `_CivicwebIndexParser` (`meeting-type-list` item-templates →
  `MeetingInformation.aspx?Id=N`), `_OnbaseIndexParser` (both verified
  shapes: `meeting-row` cells AND the embedded `SearchResults({…})` JSON
  literal), `_AgendaArchiveIndexParser` (dated agenda links, one item
  per row — background/consent/minutes/video never mint items, P8-3).
- **Fail-closed contracts**: a captured index carrying neither an item
  nor the platform's page marker is `ContentDrift`, never a silent empty
  window; a marked empty index is an honest `empty`. `parse()` intercepts
  an index capture whose endpoint declares `index_genre = "html"`;
  `extract()` emits the same `agenda_item` records as the JSON path —
  `agenda_index` rows + `meeting_date` claims + recorded document links
  (links, never fetches; no `doc_url_template`/`doc_link_keys` on the
  HTML contracts, so `discover_more` fans out nothing — P8-3).
- `_agenda_index_target_for` merges the registry row's tenant context
  onto a supplied target (the P26.10 rule).

## Registration review (read-only, 2026-11-13)

Verified serving under the shared politeness UA: Hialeah/Bexar/Savannah
AgendaCenter indexes (139/116/64 `catAgendaRow`); both CivicWeb
`MeetingTypeList` pages — platform-wide robots `Disallow: /` probed +
recorded (GL-GATE-08/ADR-088/ADR-222, never bypassed); Frisco + Maricopa
OnBase meeting-row indexes and Tampa's embedded SearchResults JSON
(Maricopa robots 503 → recorded unretrievable); Fargo's year archive
(robots 404 → no policy). Durham answers a Cloudflare 403 challenge —
recorded, never defeated. `agenda.savannahga.gov` login-walled →
censused. No live connector run was performed or claimed.
